caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical hat with a wide, flat brim. The hat is primarily dark green in color, with a narrow red band around the edge of the brim. On the vertical side of the cylindrical crown, there are several ornate decorations. Prominently displayed is a circular portrait of a man with white hair, wearing a blue coat with gold buttons and epaulets. Surrounding the portrait are golden-yellow letters on a red ribbon-like banner spelling out "TAYLOR HOSE CO." The crown of the hat also features a yellow star with a red center. The hat is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or landscape details. There are smudges and a small handwritten note in the bottom right corner.
title: Fireman's Hat
